    LABELS = ("supported", "contradicted", "insufficient_evidence")

        "dataset_sha256": __QUESTION_SHA__,
        "answer_key_sha256": __KEY_SHA__,
    }
    assert hashlib.sha256(QUESTION_BYTES).hexdigest() == DIGESTS["dataset_sha256"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(KEY_BYTES).hexdigest() == DIGESTS["answer_key_sha256"]
    QUESTIONS = json.loads(QUESTION_BYTES)
    ANSWERS = {row["id"]: row for row in json.loads(KEY_BYTES)["answers"]}

@app.function
def evidence_html(evidence):
    """Readable evidence tables with no inferred or omitted field values."""
    def display(value):
        if value is None:
            return "Not supplied (null)"
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            return "Yes" if value else "No"
        return str(value)

    def rows(value, prefix=""):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return [row for key, child in value.items()
                    for row in rows(child, f"{prefix} / {key}" if prefix else key)]
        if isinstance(value, list):
            if not value:
                return [(prefix, "Empty list")]
            return [row for index, child in enumerate(value, 1)
                    for row in rows(child, f"{prefix} / {index}")]
        return [(prefix.replace("_", " "), display(value))]

    contract = html.escape(evidence.get("contract", ""))
    fields = {key: value for key, value in evidence.items() if key != "contract"}
    if "record_a" in fields:
        left = fields.pop("record_a")
        candidates = fields.pop("candidates_b")
        records = [left, *candidates]
        keys = list(dict.fromkeys(key for record in records for key in record))
        header = "<tr><th scope='col'>Field</th><th scope='col'>Record A</th>"
        header += "".join(f"<th scope='col'>Record B{index}</th>" for index in range(1, len(candidates) + 1)) + "</tr>"
        body = "".join("<tr><th scope='row'>" + html.escape(key.replace("_", " ")) + "</th>"
                       + "".join("<td>" + html.escape(display(record.get(key))) + "</td>" for record in records)
                       + "</tr>" for key in keys)
        comparison = "<div class='orc-scroll'><table><thead>" + header + "</thead><tbody>" + body + "</tbody></table></div>"
    else:
        comparison = ""
    body = "".join("<tr><th scope='row'>" + html.escape(key) + "</th><td>"
                   + html.escape(value) + "</td></tr>" for key, value in rows(fields))
    return ("<p class='orc-contract'><strong>Rules for this case:</strong> " + contract + "</p>"
            + comparison + "<div class='orc-scroll'><table><tbody>" + body + "</tbody></table></div>")


@app.function
def submission_from_choices(choices):
    return {"dataset_version": QUESTIONS["dataset_version"],
            "responses": [{"id": qid, "label": label} for qid, label in choices.items() if label is not None]}


@app.function
def quiz_styles():
    """Keep component styles inside the same marimo shadow root as the form."""
    return """<style>
    .orc-case { border: 1px solid #94a3b8; border-radius: 10px; margin: 12px 0; padding: 12px 16px; }
    .orc-case > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 650; padding: 6px 0; }
    .orc-claim { font-size: 1.08rem; border-left: 4px solid #2563eb; padding-left: 12px; margin: 16px 0; }
    .orc-contract { font-size: .94rem; line-height: 1.5; }
    .orc-scroll { overflow-x: auto; margin: 12px 0; }
    .orc-scroll table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: .86rem; }
    .orc-scroll th, .orc-scroll td { text-align: left; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid #94a3b8; padding: 7px; }
    .orc-scroll th { font-weight: 600; }
    </style>"""


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _():
    mo.md("""
    # Odds Reality Check

    **Twelve cases. Three answers. What do the records actually prove?**

    A fresh heartbeat, a disappearing quote and an almost identical home-run
    line can each tempt you into a claim the evidence does not support.

    Open each case, read its claim and evidence, and choose your answer.
    This notebook does not send your answers to ParlayAPI. Scroll to **Score and
    reveal answers** when ready. Unanswered cases count against your score.

    - **Supported:** the evidence establishes the claim.
    - **Contradicted:** the evidence establishes the opposite.
    - **Insufficient evidence:** neither conclusion is established.

    **Everything here is fictional.** This is an open educational challenge,
    not a test of live coverage, betting profit or a model ranking. No API key,
    account, sportsbook data or AI service is used.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _():
    _cards = []
    _controls = {}
    for _index, _question in enumerate(QUESTIONS["questions"], 1):
        _qid = _question["id"]
        _controls[_qid] = mo.ui.radio(
            {"Supported": "supported", "Contradicted": "contradicted",
             "Insufficient evidence": "insufficient_evidence"},
            value=None, label=f"Your answer for case {_index}", inline=False,
        )
        _content = evidence_html(_question["evidence"])
        # Batch uses str.format; protect literal fixture braces before adding controls.
        _content = _content.replace("{", "{{").replace("}", "}}")
        _cards.append(
            f"<details class='orc-case' {'open' if _index == 1 else ''}>"
            f"<summary>Case {_index} of 12: {html.escape(_question['title'])}</summary>"
            f"<p class='orc-claim'><strong>Claim:</strong> {html.escape(_question['claim'])}</p>"
            + _content + "{" + _qid + "}</details>"
        )
    _styles = quiz_styles().replace("{", "{{").replace("}", "}}")
    quiz = mo.Html(_styles + "".join(_cards)).batch(**_controls).form(
        submit_button_label="Score and reveal answers", show_clear_button=True,
        clear_button_label="Clear choices", bordered=False,
    )
    quiz
    return (quiz,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(quiz):
    if quiz.value is None:
        result = None
        _display = mo.md("*Answers and explanations appear here only after you submit.*")
    else:
        submission = submission_from_choices(quiz.value)
        result = grade_payload(submission, QUESTIONS, ANSWERS, DIGESTS)
        _chosen = {row["id"]: row["label"] for row in submission["responses"]}
        _details = {}
        for _question in QUESTIONS["questions"]:
            _qid = _question["id"]
            _answer = ANSWERS[_qid]
            _prediction = _chosen.get(_qid)
            _mark = "Correct" if _prediction == _answer["label"] else "Unanswered" if _prediction is None else "Review"
            _details[f"{_qid}: {_mark} | {_question['title']}"] = mo.md(
                f"**Your answer:** {(_prediction or 'unanswered').replace('_', ' ')}  \n"
                f"**Expected:** {_answer['label'].replace('_', ' ')}  \n\n"
                + _answer["explanation"]
            )
        _display = mo.vstack([
            mo.Html(f"<div role='status' style='border:2px solid #2563eb;padding:16px;border-radius:10px'>"
                    f"<strong style='font-size:1.5rem'>{result['correct']} / 12</strong>"
                    f"<p>{result['answered']} answered; {result['missing']} unanswered. "
                    f"{result['false_supported_claim_count']} unsupported claims marked supported.</p></div>"),
            mo.md("**Your last submitted answers.** Changes above do not change this result until you submit again. "
                  "The key is now revealed, so further attempts are practice."),
            mo.accordion(_details, multiple=True),
            mo.download(json.dumps(result, indent=2).encode(), filename="odds-reality-check-result.json",
                        mimetype="application/json", label="Download this exercise result"),
        ])
    _display
    return (result,)
